净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Extends the multi-scale drawdown geometry by incorporating volume confirmation. Depth is multiplied by normalized volume to emphasize drawdowns with heavy participation, while duration and recovery change remain additive. This nonlinear interaction targets the mutual information bottleneck without disrupting rank stability.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

cs_rank(depth) * cs_rank(vol/vol_ma20) + cs_rank(duration) + cs_rank(delta_depth_10)
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

cs_rank(depth) * cs_rank(vol/vol_ma20) + cs_rank(duration) + cs_rank(delta_depth_10)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. add —— 加法
    add(add(multiply(cs_rank(depth), cs_rank(divide(vol, vol_ma20))), cs_rank(duration)), cs_rank(delta_depth_10))
  2. 2. add —— 加法
    add(multiply(cs_rank(depth), cs_rank(divide(vol, vol_ma20))), cs_rank(duration))
  3. 3. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(cs_rank(depth), cs_rank(divide(vol, vol_ma20)))
  4. 4. cs_rank —— 当日截面分位(0~1)
    cs_rank(depth)
  5. 5. cs_rank —— 当日截面分位(0~1)
    cs_rank(divide(vol, vol_ma20))
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(vol, vol_ma20)
  7. 7. cs_rank —— 当日截面分位(0~1)
    cs_rank(duration)
  8. 8. cs_rank —— 当日截面分位(0~1)
    cs_rank(delta_depth_10)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 1) depth = (peak_N - close) / peak_N
  2. 2) duration = 自从达到 peak 至今的天数
  3. 3) delta_depth_10 = depth[t] - depth[t-10] 10 日回撤加深量
  4. 4) vol_ratio = volume / ts_mean(volume, 20)
  5. 5) 各项各自 cs_rank 后线性组合
来源：手写步骤（factor_manual_61 / formula_lqtp 人工核对）

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. rank(depth) — rank(x) → 截面百分位排名 (0~1)
  2. rank(vol/vol_ma20) — rank(x) → 截面百分位排名 (0~1)
  3. rank(duration) — rank(x) → 截面百分位排名 (0~1)
  4. rank(delta_depth_10) — rank(x) → 截面百分位排名 (0~1)

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_volume_geometry(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] running_max = close.expanding().max() depth = (running_max - close) / running_max new_high = close == running_max group = new_high.cumsum() duration = df_copy.groupby(group).cumcount() depth_chg = depth.diff(10).fillna(0) vol_ma = volume.rolling(20).mean() vol_ratio = volume / vol_ma rank_depth = depth.rank() rank_duration = duration.rank() rank_recovery = depth_chg.rank() rank_vol = vol_ratio.rank() depth_vol = rank_depth * rank_vol factor = depth_vol + rank_duration + rank_recovery df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_volume_geometry'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_volume_geometry']
